title: Four years
venue: the coast community-college paper, Newport · the laundromat digest
logline: Four years. The strip references #1 with a tray and nothing else.

panels.composition: The community-college cafeteria, Newport — the strip's first time in it. A tray. Corn. WOOD at the register with a CASHIER who doesn't look up.

image.prompt: a community college cafeteria line, a young man in a chore coat holding out a tray as a cashier who doesn't look up ladles corn, brush-pen black and white

panels.composition: Wood. Nothing. Not even 'corn.' He just takes it.

image.prompt: close-up of a young man silently taking a tray of corn, no words

panels.composition: A long cafeteria table. Adults of all ages, none facing the same direction. Wood at the end. Nobody he knows.

characters.pose: at the end of a long table

image.prompt: a long community college cafeteria table with adult students of all ages facing every direction, a young man alone at the end

panels.composition: The Datsun in Lot C. Wood eating the corn in the car with the dog. Rain. This is where the locals go.

image.prompt: a young man and a small dog sharing a tray of corn inside an old Datsun in a rainy parking lot under a LOT C sign, black and white, no words

art.line: brush-pen over rough blue pencil; xerox grain; stark spotting; rain in frantic vertical hatching (Arc 1's aesthetic)

notes: Fourth anniversary. #1's tray, in Newport, in the car.
